what: Ascendis Pharma is a Danish biotechnology company. Its technology attaches a medicine to a carrier that releases it slowly, turning daily injections into weekly or monthly ones. Skytrofa for growth hormone deficiency and Yorvipath for hypoparathyroidism are its approved products.
customers: Endocrinologists and specialist centres, with treatment paid for by insurers and health systems.
moat: A drug delivery technology that converts existing medicines into far less frequent dosing, protected by patents and validated by two approvals.
risks: It still makes an operating loss while launching its products
Revenue is concentrated in two medicines
Reimbursement decisions in Europe and the United States determine uptake
It has raised money repeatedly and may need to again
opportunities: Revenue grew about 124% last year and about 149% a year over three years
Gross margin of 87% means scale converts quickly into profit
Hypoparathyroidism has had no good treatment, so the patient need is clear
watch: Yorvipath prescription uptake and the path to sustained profitability.
